book.name: 1 Qoronttoosa
book.title: Phawuloosa Qoronttoosa Asuntsis Xaafide Tiino Kiita

content: Geeshi Ayyaana imotitsi
Ta ishuntso, Geeshi Ayyaana imotitsibaz yin erode fana ta koyane.
Yin Xooz ammanoose wode doona baayze eequntsago gochinttii, yin eroosse oge hyanggidanno yin erane.
Xoozze Ayyaana kaalitsize asi ooden, «Yesuusa baaddintto» yaga7oos. Mahi Geeshi Ayyaana kaalitsikaayzin, ooden, «Yesuusa Laatstsii» ga7odes dandda7oosanno yin erode fana koyane.
Dumma dumma Ayyaana imotitsi yene, yezin imotitsito inggize Ayyaanize fetto.
Nu Laatstses dumma dumma oocha yene, yezin Laatstse fetto.
Nu Laatstses oochchize dumma dumma oge yene, yezin yinna ogite as ubbara oochchize Xoozze fetto.
Yezin fetes fetes ingginttide imotitsito melluntsana maaddode fana Geeshi Ayyaana qonccane.
Geeshi Ayyaana fetes cinccatitsi kumide qaala inggane; mahi fetes eratitsi kumide qaala inggane.
Ye Geeshi Ayyaanize fetes ammano, hyankkays mahi fatstsize imo inggane.

Geeshi Ayyaana fetes kille baz oochchize imo, fetes tinbbite ohize imo inggane. Fetes ayyaanappa ayyaana shaakkii erize wolqqa, fetes dumma dumma doonara ohize imo, mahi fetes dumma dumma doonara ohinttidanno billize imo inggane.
Yinnii gisho hyanno ubba oochchize ye fettii Geeshi Ayyaaniza. E koyde fana fetes fetes dumma dumma imo inggane.
Fettii galla dumma dumma billite
Fettii gallite gaama billite yene, yezin yinna dumma dumma billituntsi fettii galla. Yinnii fana, Kiristtoosa dumma dumma billituntsi yeze fettii galla fana.
Nuunii Ayhude maaqqin Girike maaqqin aro maaqqin wallo asi maaqqin, ubbuntsi fettii galla maaqqades Geeshi Ayyaanara xammaqinttida. Mahi nu ubbuntsi fettii Geeshi Ayyaana uzhida.
Nu gallite dumma dumma billite yene fattin fettii galla billite baaya.
Tohe, «Taanii kushe maaqqoosse gisho billite baaya» gayko, E yinno gayde gisho billite maaqqizanna attodaane?
Hyaye, «Taanii aafe maaqqoosse gisho galla billite baaya» gayko, E yinno gayde gisho gallappa fettii billite maaqqizanna attodaane?
Galla ubba aafe xalaala maaqqizako, nu akkora si7ode? Mahi galla ubba hyaye xalaala maaqqizako nu akkora singgode?
Yezin Xoozii fa koydanni gaara, galla gidda dumma dumma billituntsana gaddida.
Ubbuntsi fettii billite maaqqizako galla wayzi yessade?
Yezin billituntsi gaama maaqqikon, galla fetto.
Aafe kushego, «Ne taas koshshoos» ga7odes dandda7oos. Woy omma tohego, «Ne taas koshshoos» ga7odes dandda7oos.
Yezin labitsi aazize galla billituntsi nuus aadhii koshshane.
Bonchcho koshshoos ga7i nu qoppize billituntsappa bagguntsana gaama bonchchane. Mahi nu borssize nu galla billituntsana aatsii bonchchii naagane.
Be7adera borssoose galla billituntsis bonchcho koshshoos. Yezin Xoozii nu galla billituntsana wol yeltsi borssize billituntsis aadhize bonchcho inggida.
Galla billituntsi fete fetera shaako medhdhikaayzara wolis qoppode gaar mahi medhdhida.
Galla billituntsappa fete hyargginttiko billituntsi ubba eera hyargginttane. Galla billituntsappa fete bonchchinttiko billituntsi ubba eera ufayttane.
Yin ubbuntsi Kiristtoosa galla; mahi yin fete fete E billite.

Woosa keetsite Xoozii, tiino hawaaruntsana, lam7intsa nabuntsana, hyaydzintsa asttamaaruntsana, mahi kille baz oochchizuntsana, fatstsizuntsana, melluntsana maaddizuntsana, woosa keetstsa ahizuntsana, dumma dumma doonara ohizuntsana doorida.
Ubbuntsi hawaare? Ubbuntsi nabe? Ubbuntsi asttamaare? Ubbuntsi kille baz oochchane?
Ubbuntsis fatstsize imo yene? Ubbuntsi dumma dumma doonara ohine? Ubbuntsi dumma dumma doonara ohizanno billane?
Yinnii gisho ubbappa aadhize imotitsi mintsii koyote. Mahi ubbappa aadhize ogito ta yinttana beessada.
